entities.name: Duje Ajduković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Duje Ajduković is a Croatian tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 105, achieved on 9 September 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 491, achieved on 8 November 2021. He is currently the No. 7 player from Croatia.
